PR #79 opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/79

Summary of what was done:
- **`scripts/ddl_authorization_check.py`** — new pre-flight gate (same CLI/JSON contract as `tight_task_validation.py`) that fails closed on any `apply_migration` reference or DDL keyword (`DROP TABLE`, `CREATE TABLE`, `ALTER TABLE`, `CREATE INDEX`, `TRUNCATE`) unless a real `PRE-APPROVED-LIVE-DDL:` citation is present; SELECT-only SQL never triggers it.
- **`scripts/task-gateway.py`** — wired into `cmd_start()` right after `tight_task_validation.py`, before `veridian-task.py create`, using the identical `run()`/`json.loads()`/`fail()` pattern.
- **`tests/test_ddl_authorization_check.py`** — 5 pytest cases (the 4 required scenarios plus a placeholder-marker edge case); all pass, and the existing `tight_task_validation.py` tests remain green (11/11 total).
- **`ai-os/OWNER_DIRECTIVES/PROTOCOL_OWNER_AI.yaml`** — new article `A15_ddl_authorization_gate` documenting the gate and the real 2026-07-26 incident, plus updates to the engines list and `S4_SPEC` state; confirmed still the single canonical protocol file via `check_single_protocol_file.py`.

Not merged, per the task's constraint — it's up for a fresh audit pass on PR #79.
